title: tpprof 1 — theprototype performance recording (contract T1, roadmap 34)
description: One format for a profiler recording (light or detailed), a beacon report (a light recording's 10-s window, same keys) and a 'Report this moment' (30 s of light data + notes). Exported gzip-compressed as `.tpprof`. Times `t` are milliseconds since meta.startedAt. Validator: src/lib/perf/tpprof.js (validateTpprof). Unknown keys are allowed everywhere (forward compatible); known keys are typed.

build.description: the commit sha the app was built from (COMMIT_SHA)

version.description: the app version (APP_VERSION), '-dev' suffixed under vite dev

device.description: navigator.userAgent (+ GPU renderer string when exposed), clipped

gpu.description: WEBGL_debug_renderer_info renderer string, when the browser exposes it

xr.description: an immersive session presented when the recording started (a later entry is an `xr-start` event)

refreshRate.description: XR session frameRate (Hz) or the display's estimate; null = unknown

framebufferScale.description: XR framebuffer scale factor, or the renderer pixel ratio on a flat screen

game.description: the game/template id when one is playing

session.description: beacon only: random id per app run (no account id)

gpuTimer.description: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 was available, so frame.gpu is measured

t.description: ms since meta.startedAt at the END of the frame

calls.description: draw calls this frame, summed over every renderer.render() pass

cpu.description: detailed mode only: CPU ms per phase. Known phases: input, physics, modules, flow, render, other

gpu.description: detailed mode only, and only with EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2: GPU ms

kind.description: known: scene-load, teleport, grab, menu, stall, quality, xr-start, xr-end, mode, capture, moment, mark, stale-module. Unknown kinds are kept and drawn as generic markers.

detail.description: kind-specific. stall: {ms, doing: string[]}; scene-load: {scene, ms?}; quality: {level, reason}; stale-module: {id, installed, expected}; mark/moment: {text}

frames.description: how many frames the per-object numbers are averaged over

cpu.description: mean CPU ms per phase over the capture

path.description: scene path, '/'-joined names from the scene root (the profiler tree: scene → module → object → mesh)

module.description: the user module that owns it, when known

calls.description: draw calls per frame (mean over the capture)

material.description: material name or type; '+'-joined for a multi-material mesh

shadow.description: true = these calls were shadow-map passes

ms.description: CPU ms in onBeforeRender→onAfterRender (submission cost; GPU cost is not separable)

screenshot.description: a local recording: a data:image/jpeg URL; a beacon report: the uploaded file's name (the image rides the PocketBase `screenshot` field)

summary.description: derived (summarize()), never required; readers may recompute it
